title: Alteration of rock outcrops
previewText:
The City Planning Commission may authorize the alteration of a rock outcrop, provided that:

(a) the development or enlargement is not feasible without such alteration, or that the requested alteration will permit a development or enlargement that satisfies the purposes of this Chapter; or

(b) such alteration is necessary to protect the health and safety of the site occupants; and
